meta.name: add-opencode
meta.description: Use OpenCode as an agent provider. OpenRouter, OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc. via OpenCode config — not the Anthropic Agent SDK. Per group via `ncl groups config update --provider opencode`; host passes OPENCODE_* and XDG mount when spawning containers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让编码智能体通过 OpenCode 调用不同大模型。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在搭建编码智能体,并希望它们通过 OpenCode 使用多家模型。
copy.tagline_en: Make your coding agents call multiple LLMs through OpenCode.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building coding agents and want them to use multiple LLMs through OpenCode.

howto.what: 技能会检查并安装 OpenCode 运行环境:拷贝缺失文件、安装依赖、改 Dockerfile 并重建镜像;装好后 NanoClaw 代理组可以用 OpenCode 调用第三方模型(如 DeepSeek、OpenRouter)。
howto.when: 当用户要求给 NanoClaw 安装 OpenCode 后端,或让某个代理组改用 OpenCode 时触发;技能会检查缺少的文件、补齐并重建镜像。

say.text: 帮我集成 OpenCode,并改用 DeepSeek 的模型。
say.note: 装好驱动后设置模型为 DeepSeek。

say.text: 把 group-demo 切到 OpenCode 后端。
say.note: 会执行 provider 切换并重启代理组。

howto.what_en: The skill checks and installs the OpenCode environment: copies missing files, adds dependencies, edits the Dockerfile, and rebuilds the image. Afterwards, NanoClaw agent groups can use OpenCode to call third-party models like DeepSeek or OpenRouter.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to add an OpenCode backend to NanoClaw or switch an agent group to it. The skill then checks what is missing, copies files, and rebuilds the image.

say_en.text: Integrate OpenCode and switch to DeepSeek models.
say_en.note: Installs and sets DeepSeek as the model.

say_en.text: Move group-demo to the OpenCode backend.
say_en.note: Switches provider and restarts the agent group.

say_en.text: I want to use OpenRouter with claude-sonnet-4; configure OpenCode for it.
say_en.note: Configures the model and API key for OpenRouter.
